Hi Alex — thanks for the details, this is straightforward. Below are the steps and required artifacts to get you fully registered in our payments flow:

1) Vendor portal registration (required)
   - Register here: https://vendors.redwood.com/register
   - Use the legal name and EIN you listed.

2) Required documents to upload to the portal
   - Signed W-9 (PDF)
   - Bank letter or voided check showing account name and routing (PDF)
   - Remittance contact info (name, email, phone)

3) Micro-deposit verification
   - After upload our finance system triggers ACH micro-deposits to the account. Expect two small amounts (under $0.50) within 24–48 hrs. Reply to this thread with the two exact amounts to confirm.

4) PO/invoice mapping requirements
   - Please ensure invoices include the Redwood PO number in the Invoice Number field and the vendor invoice reference in the RemitTo/Notes section.
   - Invoices without a PO will be routed to our procurement queue and delay payment.

5) Timeline and first payment
   - Once micro-deposits are verified and W-9/bank letter are accepted, we assign a vendor code and map your default PO receiving account. First scheduled remit is on the next monthly payment run (typically the 1st of the following month).

6) Signatures / contracts
   - If you need the vendor agreement signed, I can send a DocuSign link. Otherwise, PO acceptance alone is sufficient for payment.

I've created a HubSpot record for KD-2027-1143 and linked the vendor portal submission there. Marissa is copied to help with PO mapping once your account is active.

Let us know when you upload the W-9 and bank letter and we'll kick off micro-deposits.

Best,
